facts.statement: The researchers created a hybrid nanocarrier by attaching a lipophilic cation called triphenylphosphonium to Coenzyme Q10 and placing it on mitochondria taken from healthy brain cells.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The treatment was given as a single intravenous injection to mice that had been induced to develop Alzheimer's disease using streptozotocin.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Tests of mitochondrial function, amyloid levels, inflammation, cell death, and behavior showed that adding the CoQ10-TPP compound improved the effectiveness of the mitochondrial transplant in treating the disease.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The study suggests that combining the antioxidant CoQ10 with mitochondrial transplantation is a promising therapeutic strategy because it significantly improved the overall treatment results.
facts.subject: animals
